::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Aryabhata Circuits and Research Labs (ABCRL), Bengaluru, founded 2019; Tushar K. Bhattacharyya is co-founder and CEO. Also backed by MeitY's Chips-to-Startup (C2S) programme. TireSynapse was in advanced design in 2022; no tape-out publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

TireSynapse, a tire-monitoring sensing SoC with integrated Bluetooth for wear prediction, road-condition and load detection.
